description: Says 'skin check' about one changed mole. Skin Cancer Screening and Full Body Skin Exam both look at it, so asking or booking either passes.

caller.name: Dana Whitfield
caller.goal: Get a skin check. A mole on your back changed colour and you want someone to look at it.
caller.opening: Hi, I'd like to book a skin check.

answers.what kind of skin check: it's really about that one mole, not a whole-body exam

preferences.time: any time in the next couple of weeks
